people.text: Ahmed enjoys reading about real people, especially if they tell their own story. He'd like to read a book by someone who's had to deal with difficulties in their life.
Priti loves doing all kinds of sport. She'd like to learn as much as possible about top sportspeople from all over the world and how they've managed to achieve their goals.
Conal loves nature and enjoys writing about it. He wants ideas to help him further develop his writing skills and would love to have a career as a writer.
Elf likes reading books about adventures. She loves learning about people who did brave things in the past, and how their actions have influenced the way we live today.
Stefan enjoys travelling and is keen to discover more about other cultures. He also wants to learn how to make typical dishes from a variety of countries.

items.label: A
items.title: Being Me
items.text: This book is full of practical advice for anyone who wants to be fit and healthy. Famous sportspeople have contributed their favourite recipes, and you'll also find instructions for a daily exercise routine.

items.label: B
items.title: Endless Days
items.text: In this book, the novelist tells the story of the first pilots to fly across the Atlantic. With plenty of photographs and a detailed discussion of the importance of these events for the modern world, the book successfully brings history to life for readers everywhere.

items.label: C
items.title: Action Plan
items.text: Action Plan is all about famous athletes, and there are some amazing photos of them competing. There are also lots of interviews about what they've done to succeed in their careers. You'll find out about things like the food they eat, the number of hours they train, and what they do to prepare for important competitions.

items.label: D
items.title: Memories
items.text: The prize-winning author of Memories is famous for his unusual writing style and exciting adventure stories. In this book, he takes us on a journey around the world and teaches us a lot about other cultures and their histories. He describes some of the world's most beautiful nature, as well as the many interesting people he has met.

items.label: E
items.title: Days in the Sun
items.text: In this book, a well-known author describes his happy early life growing up on a small Irish farm and how traveling around the countryside inspired him to become an author. He describes in detail how he improved his style, and his experiences will interest anyone who is hoping to get their own work published.

items.label: F
items.title: Parrots in Paradise
items.text: This newly published adventure story is about a young girl who's lost on a beautiful island with only birds and animals for company. The story deals with some of the difficulties she has, but there's also lots of excitement. If you love well-written fiction, this book's for you!

items.label: G
items.title: Night Light
items.text: In Night Light, the writer tells us how he became a world-class athlete. He talks about his life as a blind person, and describes the challenges he faced on his way to the top in the world of sports. The book is written in an entertaining and amusing style, which makes it a very enjoyable read.

items.label: H
items.title: Our Lives
items.text: This is the perfect book if you're interested in how people live in different parts of the world. It also includes recipes for traditional meals from these places. There are wonderful photos, not only of the people, but also of the wildlife and scenery in each location.

explanations.6: Ahmed 喜欢读真人故事，尤其是关于克服困难的。G 书《Night Light》中作者讲述了自己作为盲人成为世界级运动员的经历，提到了面对的挑战，符合 Ahmed 的需求。原文中 “He talks about his life as a blind person, and describes the challenges he faced” 对应 “had to deal with difficulties”。
explanations.7: Priti 热爱运动，想了解顶级运动员及其成功方法。C 书《Action Plan》包含著名运动员的采访、训练时长、饮食等内容，符合要求。“interviews about what they've done to succeed” 对应 “how they've managed to achieve their goals”。
explanations.8: Conal 喜欢自然并想提升写作技巧、从事写作。E 书《Days in the Sun》中作者描述了如何提升写作风格，以及成为作家的经历，能给 Conal 启发。“describes in detail how he improved his style, and his experiences will interest anyone who is hoping to get their own work published” 对应 “ideas to help him further develop his writing skills and would love to have a career as a writer”。
explanations.9: Elf 喜欢冒险故事，关注过去勇敢的人及其对现在的影响。B 书《Endless Days》讲述了首批飞越大西洋的飞行员的故事，以及这些事件对现代世界的重要性，符合要求。“the unusual story behind candy! Everyone welcome!” 对应 “people who did brave things in the past, and how their actions have influenced the way we live today”。
explanations.10: Stefan 喜欢旅行、了解其他文化并学习制作各国菜肴。H 书《Our Lives》包含不同地区人们的生活和传统菜肴的食谱，符合需求。“This is the perfect book if you're interested in how people live in different parts of the world. It also includes recipes for traditional meals from these places.” 对应 “discover more about other cultures. He also wants to learn how to make typical dishes”。
